title: Shrimp Grilled Cheese on Garlic Bread Is Wildly Indulgent
text:
1 days ago Shrimp Grilled Cheese on Garlic Bread brings shrimp scampi and a molten cheese sandwich together in one gloriously rich meal. French bread is coated with softened butter, fresh garlic, Parmesan, and parsley before being toasted into a savory foundation. Shrimp seasoned with paprika cook quickly until tender, then meet Monterey Jack and additional Parmesan between the garlicky slices. Grilling the assembled sandwich crisps the exterior and melts the cheese around every piece of shrimp. The result is buttery, smoky, stretchy, and substantial enough to make an ordinary grilled cheese seem almost unfinished.
Photo by Jason Griffith Serve it with tomato soup, a green salad, fries, or roasted vegetables, although the sandwich easily holds attention on its own. Pat the shrimp dry before cooking so they sear rather than steam, and avoid overcooking them before assembly because they will continue warming as the cheese melts. Mozzarella, provolone, pepper jack, or a seafood-friendly herb cheese can replace part of the Monterey Jack. A squeeze of lemon or pinch of red pepper flakes adds brightness to the filling. Make these for date night, game night, or a weekend lunch when restraint is not part of the plan. Have napkins ready—the cheese pull and garlic butter are worth the mess.
